# Fiveable

> Fiveable is a comprehensive AP exam and standardized test prep platform offering study guides, practice tools, and interactive learning resources across sciences, humanities, and social sciences.

Fiveable provides structured study materials for AP exams (including AP Environmental Science, AP Physics 1, and AP US Government), the Digital SAT, and college-level courses. The platform combines key term glossaries, guided practice tools, and detailed study notes to help students master exam content.

## Key Topics

- AP Exam Prep
- Study Guides
- Key Terms & Vocabulary
- Guided Practice
- AP Environmental Science
- AP US Government
- AP Physics 1
- Digital SAT
- Practice Questions
- Test Prep
- Study Notes
- Interactive Learning Tools
- CED (Course and Exam Description)
- AMSCO
- Teacher Resources

## AP Exam Prep & Pricing

- [Fiveable Plans & Pricing 2026: AP Study Tools](https://fiveable.me/pricing): Fiveable pricing plans for AP exam prep with individual, classroom, and school options.
- [SAT (Digital) Study Guides & Practice 2026](https://fiveable.me/digital-sat): Digital SAT 2026 exam prep with study guides, practice questions, and key terms.

## AP Science Study Resources

- [AP Environmental Science Key Terms & Vocabulary | Fiveable](https://fiveable.me/ap-enviro/key-terms): AP Environmental Science vocabulary study guide with key terms organized by unit.
- [AP Physics 1 Guided Practice | Fiveable](https://fiveable.me/ap-physics-1-revised/guided-practice): AP Physics 1 interactive guided practice tool for tracking progress and knowledge gaps.

## AP Social Sciences & Government

- [AP US Government Key Terms & Vocabulary | Fiveable](https://fiveable.me/ap-gov/key-terms): AP US Government vocabulary study guide with key terms organized by unit.
- [AP US Government Guided Practice | Fiveable](https://fiveable.me/ap-gov/guided-practice): AP US Government interactive guided practice tool for diagnostic assessment.

## Humanities & Social Sciences

- [American Literature – 1860 to Present - Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/american-literature-since-1860): American Literature study guide from 1860 to present covering major authors and movements.
- [Art History I – Prehistory to Middle Ages - Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/art-prehistoric-to-middle-ages): Art History study guide from Paleolithic to Middle Ages covering ancient civilizations.
- [Contemporary Art – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/contemporary-art): Contemporary Art study guide covering postmodernism, pop art, and minimalism.
- [Art and Social Justice – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/art-and-social-justice): Art and Social Justice study guide covering activism and identity representation.
- [Ancient Athletics – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/ancient-athletics): Ancient Athletics study guide covering Olympic Games and Pan-Hellenic competitions.
- [Archaeology of Mesopotamia – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/archaeology-of-mesopotamia): Mesopotamia archaeology study guide covering Neolithic through Uruk periods.

## Business & Economics

- [Corporate Finance – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/corporate-finance): Corporate Finance study guide covering financial statements and capital budgeting.
- [Advertising Strategy - Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/advertising-strategy-and-consumer-insights): Advertising Strategy study guide covering consumer behavior and targeting strategies.

## Mathematics & Advanced Topics

- [Discrete Mathematics – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/discrete-mathematics): Discrete Mathematics study guide covering logic, set theory, and cryptography.
- [Computational Mathematics – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/computational-mathematics): Computational Mathematics study guide covering numerical methods and interpolation.
- [Algebraic Logic – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/algebraic-logic): Algebraic Logic study guide covering Boolean algebra and propositional logic.
- [C*-algebras – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/c-star-algebras): C*-algebras study guide with Banach algebras and Gelfand-Naimark theorem content.

## Optional

- [Criminal Law – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/criminal-law): Criminal Law study guide covering elements of crime and criminal defenses.
